vectors.title: conforming credential
payload byte altered after signing
sealedOutput digest does not match the sealed envelope
vectors.note: Verifier is given the sealed COSE_Sign1 bytes.

vectors.title: audienceSet absent
audienceSet empty without the empty-set marker
validUntil absent
validUntil differs from relianceHorizon
issuer origin differs from the sealing origin
kid is not the sealing key thumbprint
payload is not RFC 8785 canonical
typ header is not application/vc+cose
content type header is application/vc, not the ARP subtype
vectors.note: W3C permits application/vc; the ARP profile fixes the subtype.
